text: Hey, I wanted to talk to you about our group project. I feel like you could have done better. I appreciate you bringing this up. It’s always good to reflect on our performance and learn from our experiences. I know I didn’t contribute as much as I should have, and I’m sorry for that. I was struggling with some personal issues. We all go through tough times, and it’s important to communicate with the group when you’re having difficulties. That way, we can support each other and find solutions together. You’re right. I should have been more open about what I was going through. I’ll make sure to communicate better in the future. That’s great to hear. We all have our strengths and weaknesses, and working together means understanding and accommodating each other’s needs. I also realize that I didn’t take on as many tasks as I should have. I’ll make sure to be more proactive and contribute equally next time. It’s important for everyone to share the workload and contribute their fair share. I’m glad you’re committed to improving and learning from this experience. Thank you for understanding. I really want to make it up to the group and ensure our next project is a success.
